latest.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
latest.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

latest.title: Metaplanet denies selling bitcoin worth $320 million
latest.description: Metaplanet CEO dismisses bitcoin sale rumors, confirms 43,000 BTC holdings

latest.title: South Korea’s Kospi has staged a stunning comeback. How long will the bull market last?
latest.description: South Korea's Kospi has staged a reversal from its latest rout, returning to bull-market territory as investors piled back into the semiconductor giants that dominate the index.

latest.title: Bitcoin firms ask AI labs for same tools attackers already have
latest.description: Coinbase, Block, BitGo and dozens of others signed a letter arguing that safety guardrails on frontier models are blocking legitimate security work while adversaries face no such limits.

latest.title: ‘Hormuz remains blocked’: Iran disputes Trump claims as traffic sinks to near 3-month lows
latest.description: The Persian Strait Gulf Authority said "the Strait of Hormuz remains blocked and will not be reopened until Iran's conditions are accepted."

latest.title: Crypto valuations could double as protocols link revenue to tokens: Bitwise CIO
latest.description: Bitwise’s Matt Hougan said he expects revenue-capture mechanisms to spread across DeFi applications and layer-1 networks over the next 12 to 24 months.

latest.title: Metaplanet CEO shuts down Bitcoin sale speculation after $322M transfer
latest.description: Metaplanet CEO Simon Gerovich said no Bitcoin was sold after the company moved 5,014 BTC between custodial addresses for about $8 in fees.

latest.title: Speculation on dogecoin is back to October 2025 levels. The price is down 70%
latest.description: Futures positioning has rebuilt to levels last seen when dogecoin traded at three times today's price, and more than three accounts are betting on a rebound for every one betting against.

latest.title: Bitcoin slips near $63,500 as traders look past CPI to Fed’s next tests
latest.description: An in-line inflation print removed a tail risk but gave BTC little reason to rally, leaving Jackson Hole, jobs data and the next CPI release as the market’s next catalysts.

latest.title: This Chinese firm has topped Micron and Kioxia in shipments of crucial NAND memory chips
latest.description: Counterpoint Research looked at the NAND segment of memory chips, which is benefitting along with the larger DRAM segment from artificial intelligence demand.

latest.title: Goldman says Japan's $1 trillion of reserves leaves 'plenty of capacity' for further yen interventions
latest.description: Japan has enough cash at its disposal for a couple more rounds of yen-buying on the scale of last month's intervention, Goldman Sachs says.

latest.title: South Korea's Kospi swings from bear to bull-market territory in just over a month on AI trade
latest.description: South Korean stocks rallied on Thursday, pushing the benchmark Kospi into a technical bull market.

latest.title: EVs dominate China’s car market: 5 takeaways from the country's latest auto sales data
latest.description: The China Passenger Car Association released data Tuesday showing penetration of new energy vehicles rose in July. Tesla's Model Y remained popular.

latest.title: Japan wholesale inflation eases slightly to 7.2%, undershooting expectations
latest.description: The PPI reading was lower than the 7.4% expected by economists polled by Reuters, and was down from a revised 7.3% seen in June.

latest.title: ASX shareholder plans to sue former directors over failed blockchain project
latest.description: ASX’s failed blockchain-based CHESS overhaul faces renewed governance scrutiny after the exchange admitted misleading the market.

latest.title: Inside India newsletter: Why global funds are flocking to GIFT City in Modi’s home state
latest.description: Favorable regulations, a growing local investor base, and tax holidays are giving momentum to India's GIFT City.

latest.title: Trump sued over Truth Social advance access sale
latest.description: The lawsuit, filed in U.S. District Court in Manhattan, notes that Trump's posts on his own social media site often move financial markets.

latest.title: Cerebras stock plunges 14% after second earnings report following IPO
latest.description: Cerebras Systems reported better-than-expected second-quarter revenue and raised its full-year guidance.

latest.title: Arizona crypto ATM law helps 35 scam victims recover $171K
latest.description: Qualifying new customers can receive full reimbursement, including fees, if they notify both the operator and law enforcement within 30 days.
